name: Signed Distance Field (SDF) Generation from Scanned Surfaces
aliases: 3D Texture Distance Field for Implicit Surfaces
definition: A scalar field ϕ is assigned to each grid point based on its signed distance to a triangulated surface mesh. The sign is negative inside the surface and positive outside.
summary: This method converts triangulated meshes into 3D signed distance fields by computing exact Euclidean distances from geometric primitives, unlike slice-based approaches.
